u0: At the start: the ball is still blocking the cell in front of the locked door, and the agent is not carrying the matching key. Nothing has been moved or acquired yet. The next objective is to make progress on either prerequisite: pick up the blocking ball (ideally dropping it away from the door cell so blocker_moved stays true) or pick up the door-matching key. Do not try to open the door yet; it cannot open until both the blocker is moved and the key is held.
u1: The blocking ball has been picked up and is no longer on the cell in front of the door, so the door cell is accessible; however, the agent is not carrying the matching door key. Progress so far: blocker moved. Next objective: acquire the key whose color matches the door. If the agent is currently holding the ball, it must drop it in an empty cell that is not the door-front cell (dropping it back there would undo blocker_moved and send progress back to u0) before picking up the key.
u2: The agent possesses both prerequisites: the blocking ball has been moved away from the door cell and the agent is carrying the matching door key. Progress so far: blocker moved, key acquired. Next objective: face the locked door and toggle it to unlock and open it. Once the door is open, the transition advances to u3; be careful not to drop or lose the key before opening the door, since that would fire key_lost while the door is still closed.
u3: The door is open, but the agent has not yet picked up the mission's designated target box. The key may still be held or may have been dropped to free the hands; either is fine now, because key_lost does not apply once the door is open. Next objective: move through the open door into the box room, locate the box named in the mission ("pick up the <color> box"), and pick it up with empty hands. That pickup is the final step and ends the episode.
u4: Terminal success state: the agent has picked up the mission's target box. The door was opened, the target was acquired, and the episode ends. No further objective remains.
